import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 998244353;
    static final int mod2 = 1000000009;
    static final int N = 1000010;
    static final int B = 1000000;
    static long n, x, y, ans;
    static List<Integer>[] t = new ArrayList[7];
    static int[] s = new int[7];
    static int cnt;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            t[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static int val(int x) {
        if (x < 0) return x + mod;
        return x;
    }

    static void dfs(int x, int y) {
        cnt++;
        int z = val(cnt - y);
        t[x].add(z);
        s[x] = (s[x] + z) % mod2;
        if (x == 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs(x + 1, y * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static void DFS(int x, long y) {
        if (y > n) return;
        if (y * 10 * B > n && (y + 1) * B - 1 <= n) {
            long u = y;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                int w = val(cnt - (int) u);
                long size = t[i].size();
                long lowerBoundIndex = lowerBound(t[i], mod - w);
                long tSize = size - lowerBoundIndex;
                ans += (long) w * tSize + s[i];
                ans -= tSize * (long) mod;
                u = (u * 10) % mod;
            }
            ans %= mod2;
            ad(cnt, 2222222);
            return;
        }
        if (x != 0) {
            ad(cnt, 1);
            ans += val(cnt - (int) (y % mod));
        }
        for (int i = (x == 0 ? 0 : 0); i <= 9; i++) {
            DFS(x + 1, y * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static long lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    static void ad(long[] x, long y) {
        x[0] += y;
        if (x[0] >= mod) x[0] -= mod;
    }

    static void ad(int[] x, int y) {
        x[0] += y;
        if (x[0] >= mod) x[0] -= mod;
    }

    static void solve() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            t[i].clear();
            s[i] = 0;
        }
        dfs(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            Collections.sort(t[i]);
        }
        cnt = 0;
        ans = 0;
        DFS(0, 0);
        ans = (ans % mod2 + mod2) % mod2;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        solve();
    }
}
